pages.text: By default, elephants, whales, the Laviathan and a few other giants create a placed carcass where they die. They cannot hang, so bleed them with a cleaver there for 2000 mB of blood, then cut them up in place.
pages.title: Where It Falls

pages.text: Placed-at-death does not forbid transport: breaking a whole giant carcass still recovers its item. A blood grate under it catches the blood; without one it pools. The Void Worm needs the netherite cleaver for the killing blow.

Server owners can change representation independently in alexsbutchery-server.toml under $(l)carcasses$(): $(l)deathSpawnMode$() is SPECIES_DEFAULT or PLACED_BLOCK; $(l)deathSpawnOverrides$() uses entries such as alexsmobs:moose=PLACED_BLOCK or alexsmobs:elephant=ITEM. Add actual entity IDs to $(l)groundBleedingMobs$() separately to let those fresh carcasses drain while lying down. These world settings require a restart.
